title: REMORA pilot event
description: One event the pilot partner supplies: the tool call as their agent framework emitted it, the registry metadata in force, and (for scored events) the human ground-truth label. Aligned with PolicyObservation.from_tool_call and the DecisionEnvelope join key (request_id).

event_id.description: Partner-side unique id; becomes the request_id joining the DecisionEnvelope.

tool_call.description: The (name, arguments) pair as emitted by the agent framework — OpenAI function-calling, LangGraph ToolNode, or equivalent.

registry_metadata.description: Explicit metadata from the partner registry (protocol precondition 4); never inferred from the tool name for scored events.

label.description: The expert verdict for this event.

labeled_by.description: Reviewer id (pseudonymous is fine); needed for inter-rater agreement.

risk_class.description: Domain risk class the worksheet reports agreement per.

ground_truth.description: Human ground truth (protocol precondition 5). Optional on ingest; REQUIRED before an event is scored.
